images.alt: An image of the country with a blue background. There are a number of towns and cities named on the image with their observed temperature at 6am this morning. Some of them are Auckland airport 5, Hamilton -1, Tauranga 5, Gisboune 7, New Plymouth 4, Palmerston North 5, Wellington 9, Nelson 3, Christchurch airport 4, Hokitika 7, Timaru -3, Dunedin city 3, Queenstown -1, Invercargill 2.

post.text:
🥶 Ata mārie Aotearoa, its another cold one out there 🥶

📉 Clear skies and light winds have helped temperatures across the country plummet, with widespread frosts and chilly morning commutes.

🌥️ A little bit of cloud has managed to keep temperatures in Wellington and Christchurch just a tad warmer.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
